description: This Python source file defines API routes for AI summary endpoints within a FastAPI application. It includes handlers for computing, retrieving recent, and fetching specific AI summaries. The code manages database interactions, external API calls to OpenAI, and simulation fallback if credentials are missing. It uses FastAPI dependencies, Pydantic models for request/response validation, and SQLAlchemy for database access.

classes.name: AiSummaryComputeRequest
classes.description: Data model for the request to compute an AI summary, specifying scope, period, provider, and model overrides.

classes.name: AiSummaryOut
classes.description: Response model representing a persisted AI summary including metadata, scope, text, cost, and timestamps.

methods.name: AiSummaryOut _summary_to_out(s: AiSummary)
methods.description: Convert ORM AiSummary object to API response model AiSummaryOut.

methods.name: Dict[str,Optional[UUID]] _resolve_scope_refs(db: Session, scope: Scope, scope_id: Optional[UUID])
methods.description: Resolve and verify scope references (org, repo, user) based on scope type and ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _fetch_lightweight_metrics( db: Session, *, org_id: Optional[UUID], repo_id: Optional[UUID], period_start: date, period_end: date, )
methods.description: Retrieve aggregated metrics for a given scope and period, simplified for prompt generation.

methods.name: str _build_prompt(*, scope: Scope, period_start: date, period_end: date, metrics: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Construct a prompt string for AI summarization, including scope, period, and optional metrics.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _call_openai_chat(*, api_key: str, model: str, prompt: str)
methods.description: Asynchronous function to call OpenAI's chat completion API with given model and prompt.

methods.name: str _simulated_summary_text(*, scope: Scope, period_start: date, period_end: date, metrics: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Generate a deterministic, marked-up simulated summary used when API key is missing or call fails.

methods.name: AiSummaryOut compute_summary(req: AiSummaryComputeRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: API route handler to compute/persist an AI summary for a scope and period, handling fallback if API key missing.

methods.name: List[AiSummaryOut] recent_summaries( org_id: Optional[UUID] = Query(default=None, description="Optional org UUID to filter."), repo_id: Optional[UUID] = Query(default=None, description="Optional repo UUID to filter."), subject_type: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional subject_type filter (repo|org|user|system)."), limit: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=200, description="Max summaries returned."), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: API route handler to list recent summaries, with optional filtering parameters.

methods.name: AiSummaryOut get_summary_by_id( summary_id: UUID = Path(..., description="AI summary UUID."), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: API route handler to retrieve a specific persisted summary by its UUID.
